package contract_types

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "reflect"
    "testing"
)

func TestModelWire(t *testing.T) {
    original := `{"record-id":"id","score":3,"children":[],"numbers":{"1":"0.12345678901234567890123456789","2":null},"samples":[true,null,false],"mode":"ready","choice":{"value":"item","content":"id"},"instant":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","duration":"PT1S","uuid":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","bytes":"YQ=="}`
    var decoded SampleDataRecord
    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(original), &decoded); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if decoded.Label.Present { t.Fatal("absent label became present") }
    actual, err := json.Marshal(decoded)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    var want, got map[string]any
    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(original), &want); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := json.Unmarshal(actual, &got); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if !reflect.DeepEqual(want, got) { t.Fatalf("roundtrip changed wire shape: %s", actual) }
    for key, bad := range map[string]any{"label":nil,"record-id":nil,"unknown":true,"choice":map[string]any{"value":"invalid","content":"id"}} {
        var value map[string]any
        if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(original), &value); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
        value[key] = bad
        raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
        if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
        if json.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded) == nil { t.Fatalf("accepted invalid %s", key) }
    }
    delete(want, "record-id")
    missing, err := json.Marshal(want)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if json.Unmarshal(missing, &decoded) == nil { t.Fatal("accepted missing required wire key") }
    var omitted SampleDataChoice
    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"value":"omitted"}`), &omitted); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    raw, err := json.Marshal(omitted)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if string(raw) != `{"value":"omitted"}` { t.Fatalf("omitted payload changed: %s", raw) }
}
